# PrintableCalendars

> Free printable monthly and annual calendars with official public holidays for USA, Japan, and South Korea. A4 PDF, instant download, no login required.

## What this site offers

- Monthly printable calendars by country and month (USA, Japan, South Korea)
- Annual year-view calendars with all 12 months
- Official public holiday data for each supported country
- Cultural holiday guides (Chuseok, Golden Week, Thanksgiving, Ramadan, etc.)
- World events calendar (100+ international observances)
- Specialty planners: study planner, teacher planner, holiday planner, wedding countdown calendar

## Key facts

- Completely free — no account, no payment, no watermark
- Calendars include official public holidays only (not observances or regional-only days)
- PDF format: A4 landscape, optimized for both color and black-and-white printing
- Holiday data sourced from the date-holidays open-source library
- Supported countries: United States (US), Japan (JP), South Korea (KR)

## How to get a calendar

1. Go to /calendar/{country}/{year}/{month} — e.g. /calendar/us/2026/6
2. The calendar displays with all public holidays marked
3. Click "Download PDF" — downloads instantly, no login required

## Site structure

- /calendar/{country}/{year}/{month} — Monthly calendar page (US, JP, KR)
- /calendar/{country}/{year} — Annual year-view calendar
- /events — World events index (100+ international observances)
- /events/{slug} — Individual world event with history and cultural context
- /holidays — Cultural holidays index
- /holidays/{slug} — In-depth cultural holiday guide
- /study-planner — Printable study planner for students
- /teacher-planner — Printable planner for teachers
- /school-calendar-2026 — School year calendar 2026
- /holiday-planner — Holiday and travel planner calendar
- /wedding-countdown — Wedding countdown calendar
- /ramadan-2026 — Ramadan 2026 calendar with dates
- /about — About PrintableCalendars
- /contact — Contact page

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Is PrintableCalendars free?
A: Yes. All calendars are completely free — no account, no payment, no watermark.

Q: Which countries are supported?
A: USA, Japan, and South Korea. Australia, Canada, UK, and Germany are planned.

Q: What file format?
A: A4 landscape PDF, suitable for any home or office printer.

Q: Do calendars include public holidays?
A: Yes. All official public holidays for the selected country are included.

Q: How do I download?
A: Navigate to the calendar page and click "Download PDF". No login required.
